nodes.header: Pitfalls: Motivating teammates and team members
Steps: Show genuine care for your teammates
nodes.body: First step: Show genuine care for each teammate as a person, not just as a team member. Caring is the foundation that makes the other motivation steps land. Source: John told Tim 'When motivating others, it's important to show care for teammates' (2023-12-06, conv-43_session_21).

nodes.header: Steps: Celebrate teammates' achievements
nodes.body: Second step: Actively celebrate teammates' wins and milestones — whether on the field or off. Recognition reinforces effort and builds momentum. Source: John told Tim '[motivate by] celebrate their achievements' (2023-12-06, conv-43_session_21).

nodes.header: Steps: Provide constructive feedback
nodes.body: Third step: Give honest, constructive feedback that helps teammates grow. Feedback paired with care (step 1) doesn't feel like criticism — it feels like investment in their development. Source: John told Tim '[motivate by] provide constructive feedback' (2023-12-06, conv-43_session_21).

nodes.header: Steps: Remind teammates of the bigger goal
nodes.body: Fourth step: When energy is low or focus drifts, reconnect teammates to the team's bigger goal. The shared mission gives day-to-day grind meaning. Source: John told Tim '[motivate by] remind them of the bigger goal' (2023-12-06, conv-43_session_21).

nodes.header: Steps: Create a positive team environment
nodes.body: Fifth step: Cultivate a positive team environment in everyday interactions. Consistent positivity at the team level lifts everyone's baseline motivation, not just individual moments. Source: John told Tim 'Creating a positive environment... can also be helpful' (2023-12-06, conv-43_session_21).

nodes.header: Steps: Give a pep talk before a game or key moment
nodes.body: Sixth step: For high-stakes moments (a game, a presentation, a launch), deliver a pep talk that channels the team's energy and reminds them what's at stake and what they're capable of. Source: John told Tim 'giving a pep talk before a game can also be helpful' (2023-12-06, conv-43_session_21).

nodes.header: Steps: Lead by example through hard work
nodes.body: Seventh step: Set the tone yourself by working hard and modeling the effort you want from others. People follow what they see, not what they're told. Source: Tim told John 'setting an example by working hard can really inspire people' (2023-12-06, conv-43_session_21).

nodes.header: Steps: Share your own stories to encourage others
nodes.body: Eighth step: Use your own experiences and journey — wins, struggles, lessons learned — to encourage and inspire teammates. Personal stories land harder than abstract advice. Source: Tim told John 'It's also inspiring to use our own stories to encourage others' (2023-12-06, conv-43_session_21).
